extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF results and Figure 6 locators.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill assays support rapid bactericidal activity against S. aureus AB94004, with concentration-dependent killing for marcin-18, meucin-18, and megicin-18.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative curve points are figure-level and are not converted into exact numeric time-series values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SYTOX Green fluorescence assays support membrane permeabilization/disruption after peptide exposure, with dose-dependent response for the reported peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact fluorescence curve values are not tabulated in local source material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM morphology supports peptide-induced bacterial envelope disruption after 4x MIC exposure for 30 minutes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Marcin-18, Meucin-18, Megicin-18 against S. aureus AB94004
mechanism_claims.limitations: Qualitative ultrastructural finding; no invented numeric damage score.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LPS/LTA competition assays do not support LPS or LTA as the primary antimicrobial target for the three peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Preserved as target-site counterevidence rather than a positive binding mechanism.
